title: ZX Bank – Bill Payments & Auto Debit Feature

nodes.title: Supported Bill Payment Categories
nodes.summary: Bill payments cover credit cards (ZX Bank and other banks), mobile/postpaid bills, prepaid mobile recharge, DTH, broadband and landline, electricity/water/gas, insurance premiums, educational fees and municipality taxes, with more coming soon.

nodes.title: Auto Debit Feature
nodes.summary: Auto debit ensures recurring bills are always paid on time by automatically debiting a ZX Bank account or credit card on a custom schedule, with alerts and full control to modify or cancel mandates.

children.title: How Auto Debit Works
children.summary: Register billers online via Mobile App or NetBanking, choose the payment date (due date or an earlier preferred day), let ZX Bank process payments automatically, receive SMS/email alerts before each debit, and modify or stop mandates anytime under Manage Mandates.

nodes.title: Key Features
nodes.summary: One-time biller setup, secure payments via OTP/biometric/device authentication, 400+ billers across India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Bhutan and Nepal, real-time tracking of payment history and upcoming debits, plus an AI assistant named Zia for reminders and support.

nodes.title: How To Get Started
nodes.summary: Steps to begin: download the ZX Bank Asia Mobile App, log in or complete e-KYC onboarding, open Bill Payments or Auto Debit to add the biller and enable auto debit with preferences, then confirm and save.

children.title: Need Help?
children.summary: Support options: ask the in-app assistant Zia, visit www.zxbank.asia/support, call the 24x7 helpline, or visit the nearest branch.
